item.title: With Abbott out, what does the future look like for data centers in Texas?
item.description: Texas has been one of the most welcoming states for data centers, but that might change with a new governor coming in.

item.title: Trump effectively ended asylum. Advocates look to the Supreme Court to restore it
item.description: Trump's sweeping immigration changes — an asylum ban, mass firings and new legal maneuvers — have all but ended asylum. The high court will soon consider whether some shifts deny people due process.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: After Democrats' midterm wins, some hope attacks on DEI will ease
item.description: After the midterms, a Democratic congressman declared that DEI is back. What does Democrats' ascendance portend for diversity initiatives that the Trump administration relentlessly attacked?

item.title: Storms disrupt Thanksgiving travel. And, FCC violated ABC's free speech, judge says
item.description: The East Coast's weather is a major concern this holiday, as it could lead to coastal flooding. And, the judge says the FCC can't punish ABC for satire Trump doesn't like.

item.title: Court lets Puerto Rico governor fire firm that runs the island's troubled power grid
item.description: LUMA Energy took over the electric grid five years ago. The court's ruling nullifies its contract, and gives the government a year to find a new operator.

item.title: U.S. Judge rules FCC violated ABC's free speech rights to please Trump
item.description: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration from moving to review all local broadcast licenses held by ABC. The stations air in six of the largest U.S. markets.

item.title: Group of Senate Democrats push to add freshman to leadership
item.description: Several Democratic senators have been signaling this move, saying the party needs to acknowledge the diverse class of incoming freshman that catapulted the party to victory in November.
